title: Violette (FCP 2026)
synopsis:
The peaceful life of Violette, a cemetery caretaker in a small town in Burgundy, is disrupted when a local police chief’s arrival uncovers long-buried secrets, pushing her to face her past to take another chance on life and love.

 

Q/A with the director Jean-Pierre Jeunet after the screening on 18 NOVEMBER at PREMIERE ELEMENTS.

synopsis_lang.zh_hk:
Violette在勃艮第小鎮擔任墓園管理員，生活平靜。當地警察局長的到來卻揭露了深藏已久的秘密，打破了她安穩的日子，迫使她面對過去，重新把握人生與愛情的機會。

 

11月18日PREMIERE ELEMENTS 場次放映後將設有導演Jean-Pierre Jeunet問答環節。
